verdict.rationale: Supabase's own tooling lets you capture changes as migration files kept in version control, and Branching gives each pull request an isolated preview environment for review. Its automations (Cron, Database Webhooks, Edge Functions) live in that same project and database, but the evidence never says automation definitions specifically are versioned or reviewed this way. Rollback is not documented; daily backups are a different capability. Missing for 10: explicit versioning of cron jobs, webhooks and functions as automations, a documented rollback or revert mechanism for automations, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
